messages:
dalia: Quick debrief from today's AuroraGrid interview. Recording + raw transcript uploaded: https://drive.redwood.ai/auroragrid/interview. Need checklist: redlined transcript, public-safe quote, embargo timing, 30s hero clip + webinar soundbites, EN/FR captions, tracking UTMs, and lead routing to Carlos.

soren: Sounds good. They mentioned a few telemetry points (p95 numbers and a raw request id) legal will want those removed. Also they gave a succinct quote: "Redwood cut our batch inference costs by half".

tia: For socials and webinar we should prefer: "reduced inference costs by ~50%". I'll prep a hero clip + 3x15s webinar bites. Can ops confirm captions vendor? :speech_balloon:

legal-bot: Automated check: NDA on file, release template `customer-release-v2` required. Public copy must avoid exact p95/p99 and internal IDs; redact hostnames and request hashes. If customer insists on publishing exact numbers, add signed telemetry addendum. Final legal sign-off requires redlined transcript attached to the release form.

ops-bot: Caption vendor options: FastTrans (24h, auto) or LocalLingo (72h, native review). Ops recommends FastTrans for launch velocity. Will add UTMs and pixel once copy and embargo time confirmed.

dalia: OK I'll send two public quote options to the customer: (A) "Redwood reduced our inference costs by ~50% while speeding up response times." (B) "We saw meaningful latency and cost improvements after switching to Redwood." Ask them to OK the public wording.

soren: Also request permission to use their logo on the landing page. If they want co-branding language, loop in partnerships.

tia: Deliverables & ETA: hero_30s.mp4 + 3x15s clips + EN/FR captions uploaded to Drive by EOD today if vendor selected. I'll tag assets with `utm_campaign=auroragrid_launch`.

ops-bot: Example UTM landing: `https://redwood.ai/auroragrid?utm_campaign=auroragrid_launch&utm_source=twitter&utm_medium=social`. Routing rule: if lead_tag contains `case-benchmark` -> assign to AE Carlos (carlos@redwood.ai) with priority high-touch. Pixel and HubSpot flow will be staged once embargo set.

legal-bot: Reminder: include the redlined transcript as an attachment in the release form and get explicit signed public quote agreement. Legal will mark green once attachments and signed PDF received.

dalia: Sent the two public-safe options and logo usage request to the customer (BCC legal). Requested approval within 48 hours.

soren: Customer replied: approves option A and granted logo usage. Signed release attached (uploading now). They did not want exact p95 numbers in the public quote.

ops-bot: Received signed release. Staging pixel and HubSpot flow now live for testing. Routing tests pass; demo assigned to Carlos.

tia: Uploading clips and EN captions: https://drive.redwood.ai/auroragrid/assets (hero_30s.mp4, webinar_15s_1.mp4, webinar_15s_2.mp4, webinar_15s_3.mp4, captions_en.srt). FR captions pending vendor - FastTrans ETA 24h.

dalia: Redlined transcript uploaded and attached to the release form. Legal, please review when able.

legal-bot: Reviewing redlines. All checks green. No PII or internal IDs in the public copy. Telemetry addendum not required. Legal flips final sign-off to green.

dalia: Thanks everyone. Embargo set for 2026-04-30 09:00 PT. Ops - please schedule landing page publish and social posts at embargo time and include webinar CTA for 2026-05-14 deep-dive.

ops-bot: Scheduled landing + social queue for 2026-04-30 09:00 PT. HubSpot rules and pixel active. UTM and `lead_tag=case-benchmark` will route to Carlos.

ae-carlos: I'll prep outreach templates and monitor hot-leads at launch. Thanks team! :rocket:
